hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d);process.stdout.write(j.tool_input.file_path||'')}catch(e){}})" | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.tsx|*.jsx|*.md) npx prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null;; esac; case "$f" in *.tsx|*.jsx) npx eslint --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null;; esac; } || true
